approach: A new feature package com.acme.shortener.qr. QrCodeController serves GET /{code:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}}/qr, public and @RateLimited(REDIRECT) like RedirectController. QrCodeService loads the link with LinkRepository.findByCode and accepts it only if Link.isActive(); otherwise it throws the existing LinkNotFoundException (404, link-not-found). It reads the database rather than LinkService.resolve so a deletion takes effect at once, independent of the redirect cache (BF-1). It validates size (default 256, 128-1024, else InvalidQrSizeException: 400 invalid-qr-size) and calls QrCodeEncoder, which encodes {shortener.base-url}/{code} with ZXing core (error correction M, quiet zone 1) and writes a 1-bit PNG with ImageIO.

alternativesConsidered.whyNot: The redirect cache is not evicted on delete (BF-1), so a deleted link would keep getting QR codes for up to 24 h.
Scans would bypass the redirect: no click analytics, and deleting the link would not stop a printed code from working.

alternativesConsidered.option: Write a QR encoder by hand
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: QR encoding (Reed-Solomon, masking, versions) is easy to get subtly wrong; ZXing core is the standard library, small, with no transitive dependencies.

components.name: com.acme.shortener.qr.QrCodeController
components.responsibility: GET /{code}/qr with an optional Integer size; returns image/png with Cache-Control max-age=0, private. Public and rate limited like the redirect.

components.name: com.acme.shortener.qr.QrCodeService
components.responsibility: Active-link check from LinkRepository (LinkNotFoundException otherwise), size default and validation, builds the short URL from ShortenerProperties.baseUrl().

components.name: com.acme.shortener.qr.QrCodeEncoder
components.responsibility: ZXing QR encoding of text into a size x size 1-bit PNG; deterministic for the same input.

components.name: com.acme.shortener.qr.InvalidQrSizeException
components.responsibility: Raised for a size outside 128-1024; mapped by ProblemDetailsHandler to 400 /problems/invalid-qr-size (new ProblemTypes.INVALID_QR_SIZE).

components.name: Configuration
components.responsibility: No new configuration properties. The size limits are part of the API contract; the feature uses the existing shortener.base-url and shortener.rate-limit.redirect-* settings and starts with the defaults.

risks.risk: A public image endpoint is CPU work anyone can trigger
risks.mitigation: Size capped at 1024 px; the redirect rate limit applies per visitor.

risks.risk: The new route shadows an existing path
risks.mitigation: The code pattern excludes '/'; the existing API and redirect tests run unchanged.
ZXing core only (no javase helpers), pinned version, approved through CHG-002.

rolloutPlan: Ships with the next release; no feature flag because the endpoint is additive and needs no configuration. Rollback: revert the merge commit (no data or schema changes).
